title: Meituan open-sources LongCat-2.5, a 1.6T-parameter agent model trained on Huawei Ascend
summary: Meituan&\#x27;s LongCat team published the weights for LongCat-2.5 about a week after unveiling the model, releasing them under the MIT license, which permits commercial use. The mixture-of-experts model totals roughly 1.6 trillion parameters with about 48 billion active per token, and accepts text, image, and video input; it is positioned for agents that carry out long, multi-step tasks, especially coding. Meituan says training used only Chinese silicon — Huawei Ascend accelerator cards — with no Nvidia GPUs, and reports a Terminal Bench v2.1 score of 88.4, just below the 89.1 it attributes to Claude Opus 5. The account comes from a Telegram aggregator citing The Decoder, and the training-hardware and benchmark claims have not been independently verified.
